abstract: Bilaterality, complications and associated pathology were reevaluated in 286 cases of mature teratoma of the ovary, treated in the last 25 years. Torsion was the most frequent complication, occurring in 22 (7.7%) patients. Rupture, infection and secondary malignant change were uncommon complications, occurring in 11 (3.8%), 7 (2.4%) and 1 (0.3%) patients, respectively. Both ovaries were evaluated histologically in 226 patients, 31 (13.7%) of whom were shown to have bilateral tumours, including 2 patients with tumour in the normally appearing ovary, contralateral to the gross tumour.
abstract_ja: 本研究は、過去25年間に治療された卵巣成熟奇形腫286例について、両側性、合併症および併存病変を再評価した。捻転が最も多く、22例（7.7%）に認められた。破裂、感染、悪性転化はそれぞれ11例（3.8%）、7例（2.4%）、1例（0.3%）で、まれであった。226例で両側卵巣を組織学的に評価し、31例（13.7%）で両側性腫瘍が認められた。このうち2例は、肉眼的に正常に見えた対側卵巣に腫瘍を認めた。
